subject: POC: Atlas Payments - Success criteria & KPIs (next steps)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@atlaspayments.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial success criteria (recap & next steps)

Hi Olivia / Raj — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial next week. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of call:
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for live payments fraud alerts enrichment (inline enrichment pipeline). Primary goal is safe production performance at scale.
- POC scope: integration with Atlas staging API, 2 model routes (fast-response & high-quality), 48h steady-state run during business hours, standard test traffic replay from last 7 days.

Proposed success criteria / KPIs (we discussed these on the call):
1) Latency: p95 end-to-end inference latency <= 120ms for the fast route; p95 <= 500ms for high-quality route.
2) Throughput: sustained 500 req/s per route during peak 30-minute windows (burstable to 1k req/s).
3) Cost: target cost <= $0.0035 per token (combined amortized cost + infra) for the fast route.
4) Quality: precision @ top-1 >= 92% on your labelled sample set (we'll agree on evaluation prompts); acceptable false positive rate <= 2%.
5) Reliability: 99.9% success rate (no 5xx), graceful fallback to a smaller model on overload.

Evaluation plan and ownership:
- Atlas: provide test traffic replay (Anonymized) + labeled evaluation set (Olivia, Raj) — by Thu 3/22.
- Redwood: provide integration guide + Docker image and a baseline performance bench (Jordan) — by Fri 3/23.
- Metrics & monitoring: Redwood will stream token/latency/cost metrics to a shared dashboard; Atlas will validate quality metrics in the Drive eval sheet. (Marissa to set up dashboard).

Timeline:
- 3/23: integration artifacts exchanged
- 3/26: staging integration complete
- 3/27–3/29: 48h steady-state POC run
- 3/30: results review + decision on next steps (expand to production or iterate)

Next steps (action owners):
- Olivia: share anonymized test traffic + evaluation labels (due 3/22)
- Jordan: send integration guide and baseline bench + DocuSign for POC Statement of Work (due 3/23)
- Marissa: create shared dashboard and invite Atlas (due 3/24)

Attachments: I attached a one-page POC MAP (Atlas-POC-MAP-v1.pdf) and our baseline bench (redwood-performance-bench.xlsx).

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0123 | jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@atlaspayments.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial success criteria (recap & next steps)

Thanks Jordan — this looks like an accurate recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- For latency, the 120ms p95 target is for the enrichment-only portion; our pipeline currently adds ~30ms network overhead to staging, so please call out inference-specific vs end-to-end where possible.
- For quality, we'll provide the labeled set (1,200 records) but want to ensure we have the same prompt templates you used in the bench. Can you confirm templates are included in the attachment?
- On cost: Raj asked if the $0.0035/token target assumes the fast route uses 8-bit quantization and no KV cache; please call out assumptions.

We can deliver the replay file and labels by EOD Thu 3/22. We'll need Redwood's integration guide to complete the staging wiring.

Olivia

All — thanks for the quick responses and confirmations. Updated notes/assumptions below and final asks to keep things on schedule.

Assumptions (explicit):
- Latency targets: specified as inference-only p95; we will capture end-to-end separately in the dashboard.
- Cost baseline: $0.0035/token assumes 8-bit quantization on the fast route, persistent KV cache disabled for fairness. We'll include both quantized and fp16 numbers in the bench.
- Quality eval: Jordan will include the exact prompt templates used in the bench in Drive (see link). Atlas labels will be compared against model top-1.

Final asks / immediate next steps:
- Olivia: please upload anonymized replay + labels to the Drive folder by EOD today (3/22).
- Raj: please confirm any security checklist items that would block staging access (I can loop in Security if needed).
- Atlas & Redwood: sign the one-page POC SoW — DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/req/ATLAS-POC-17 (please sign by 3/23).

If we get the artifacts and signatures on time we will start the staging run 3/26 as discussed. Looking forward to it.

Best — Jordan
